lines: I believe in you, who declared, “I don’t believe what I can’t see.”
Alone on a broken ship.
A burnt-out filament, a landmark illuminating the cold sky,
even on nights when it blurs away.
(Respond, no man's world) I am searching for you (for you).
(Respond, no man's world) Where are you now?
So warm it hurts,
enough to melt away even freezing loneliness.
That voice that said, “I am not afraid of the future,”
and lit up my heart, still remains.
I will go wipe away those diamond-like tears.
With a GPS still broken, and the destination still unfixed,
I search for the reason for this long journey.
With a design so easily scarred, so weak and fragile,
why was I born? Ah.
(Respond, no man's world) I cannot breathe (I cannot).
(Respond, no man's world) Even so, I will sing.
In a world without answers,
I think the smile that gives no answers is the answer.
Let us live this uncertain present.
Even if I must drift through endless space, I want to see the future through with you.
So warm it hurts,
enough to melt away even freezing loneliness.
That voice that said, “I am not afraid of the future,”
and lit up my heart, still remains.
(To this endless path) a lamp.
(To this soundless space) a singing voice.
(To this finite journey) a blessing.
From a world (of just one, just one).
Beyond (just one, just one).
To your side (just one, just one).
